content.text:
Super common at 28 months, since toddlers often get wary of new foods, and green ones most of all. Try putting one small bite of a green thing on his plate next to something he already likes, with no pressure to eat it. Let him see you eating it too. It can take a lot of exposures before he tries it, so a plain "no thanks" still counts as progress. Blending spinach into a smoothie or pancakes can work alongside that, but the plate exposure is what builds the habit.

Also, I used to tell you I couldn't sign kids up for things, and that was wrong. If you send me a program's registration page, I can try signing him up once you say yes.
